title: Green synthesis of iron oxide nanoparticles from Mexican prickly poppy (Argemone mexicana): assessing antioxidant activity for potential therapeutic use
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,10287-10297
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA07232D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Aarti Nughwal, Ruchi Bharti, Ajay Thakur, Monika Verma, Renu Sharma, Annu Pandey
Green synthesis of iron oxide nanoparticles using Argemone mexicana leaf extract serves as a sustainable route. The biosynthesized nanoparticles exhibit strong antioxidant activity, demonstrating potential for therapeutic applications.
